Mr. Westgate has 13 years of related experience in the surveying field
and has been a licensed surveyor for 8 years. Mr. Westgate has 5 years
of field related experience where he has proficient knowledge on the
use of total stations, GPS units and digital levels to complete
topographic surveys for the design of roads, bridges, water mains,
sanitary sewer and other structures. His experience also includes 7
years of office related tasks that involved processing field data, creating
property mosaics, and establishing existing right of way. This work was
performed as a subconsultant to the Pennsylvania Department of
Transportation, Michigan Department of Transportation and other local
and private entities. Processing was completed using Microstation with
Inroads software, OpenRoads and AutoCAD Civil3D. Mr. Westgate also
has experience using Carlson Export, Trimble Business Center,
Corpscon, and Microsoft Office to Aid in the post processing of field
data, as well as for the use of keeping detailed records. ProjectWise was
also utilized to manage project content.
